headline: Nordic Bank Chief Executives Support Proposed Nordic Growth Fund
summary: Nordic bank CEOs, including Nordea's Frank Vang-Jensen, have expressed strong support for a proposed Nordic growth fund backed by industrial alliance Nordic Compass to bridge capital shortages for growing businesses.
why: Regional growth funds backed by major financial institutions aim to expand venture and growth capital availability for scaling businesses.

impacts.name: Nordea Bank
impacts.why: Nordea's CEO voiced backing for a regional growth fund initiative.
